system: You highlight spans in a document by wrapping them in tags. You never change, summarise, translate or add text, and you never type values yourself. You output only the tagged document.
prompt:
Return this document exactly as given, with tags around the spans listed below. Do not change, omit, reorder or add any text. Do not paraphrase. Do not fix typos. If a field is not present, do not tag it. Never nest one tag inside another. Output only the tagged document (no preamble, no code fence, no commentary).

Document type: licensor_terms

Tags to use (wrap the span that IS the value; keep the label text outside the tag):
- <terms_version>: the version of these terms
- <effective_date>: the effective date of this version
- <licensor_name>: the name of the licensor publishing the terms
- <permitted_use>: each clause describing a permitted use for a licence tier (one tag per clause; add clause="4.1")
- <excluded_use>: each clause describing an excluded / not-permitted use or a restriction such as requiring another tier (one tag per clause; add clause="...")
- <governing_terms_clause>: the clause saying which version of the terms governs a licence (add clause="...")
- <administrator_clause>: the clause saying claims may be administered by a third-party rights administrator (add clause="...")
- <administrator_name>: the name of the rights administrator, only if the terms name one

Worked example 1 (a receipt):
--- input ---
Order date: 19 August 2025
Order ID: GA-2025-08231
Item: Glasslight — Standard licence
--- output ---
Order date: <purchase_date>19 August 2025</purchase_date>
Order ID: <order_id>GA-2025-08231</order_id>
Item: <purchased_work_title>Glasslight</purchased_work_title> — <licence_tier>Standard</licence_tier> licence

Worked example 2 (a licence document with numbered clauses; one tag per clause, clause number as an attribute):
--- input ---
4. Uses
4.1 The licence permits use of the Work in podcasts.
4.2 The licence does not permit use in advertising.
9.1 This licence is governed by the terms in force on the date of purchase.
--- output ---
4. Uses
4.1 <permitted_use clause="4.1">The licence permits use of the Work in podcasts.</permitted_use>
4.2 <excluded_use clause="4.2">The licence does not permit use in advertising.</excluded_use>
9.1 <governing_terms_clause clause="9.1">This licence is governed by the terms in force on the date of purchase.</governing_terms_clause>

Glasswork Audio — Licence Terms

Version 3, effective 1 June 2025

These terms apply to licences purchased from glasswork.audio. Earlier versions are archived at glasswork.audio/terms/archive.

1. Definitions
1.1 "Work" means the sound recording identified in your order and Licence Certificate.
1.2 "Licensee" means the person or organisation named on the Licence Certificate.

2. Grant
2.1 Glasswork Audio Ltd grants the Licensee a non-exclusive, worldwide licence to use the Work as set out in section 4.

3. Ownership
3.1 Glasswork or its licensors retain all copyright in the Work.

4. Permitted and excluded uses
4.1 Standard licence permits use of the Work as background music in personal, non-commercial video content. Monetised use requires a Pro licence.
4.2 Pro licence permits use of the Work as background music in video content, including monetised video, broadcast, advertising and client work.
4.3 No licence permits redistribution of the Work as a standalone audio file.

5. Attribution
5.1 Attribution is appreciated but not required.

6. Term
6.1 The licence is perpetual for content published while the licence is in force.

7. Refunds
7.1 Licences are non-refundable once the Work has been downloaded.

8. Liability
8.1 Glasswork's liability is limited to the price paid for the licence.

9. Governing terms
9.1 Your licence is governed by the terms in force on the date of purchase. Later changes to these terms do not reduce rights already granted under an earlier version.

10. Content matching
10.1 Content matching claims on platforms may be administered by a third-party rights administrator acting on our behalf.
10.2 If you receive a claim on licensed content, contact support@glasswork.audio with your order number and we will ask the administrator to review it.

Glasswork Audio Ltd, 14 Foundry Lane, Sheffield S3 8AB, United Kingdom.
